"Depreciation shields on capex-heavy businesses: this is the big one, and it's legit. If you own a railroad, cable system, or utility, you get to depreciate those assets (often on an accelerated schedule, sometimes with bonus depreciation), which creates large paper losses that offset taxable income even while the business is generating real cash. Malone built TCI on exactly this — the company reported minimal or negative accounting profits for years while cash flow was strong, and it kept buying more capital-intensive stuff to keep the depreciation pipeline going. This is well documented and not an exaggeration."
